records_captured: Held-item effect-text rows, scoped to item names actually reported by MunchStats tournament rosters

fields.name: item_name
fields.description: Item display name as reported in tournament roster data (Title Case, e.g. "Choice Band")

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: API endpoint the record was extracted from

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: Item names are matched to PokéAPI's slug via a lowercase/hyphenate transform (pipelines/extract/pokeapi.py's _slugify); a name PokéAPI doesn't slug the same way would fail to resolve and simply be skipped rather than mis-mapped.
